summary: Official warnings state that this drug may raise the risk of infections, so healthcare providers should check blood counts before treatment, avoid starting it during active infections, and watch for signs of illness during use and for three months after stopping [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated a high score of 67 for the liver [M]. The same computer model also gave the drug a low score of 41 for the heart [M].
